name: gh-setup
description: One-time GitHub repo initialization: label SSOT sync, Projects v2 kanban board, docs/ tree scaffold, and ai-metrics footer backfill.

interface.longDescription: gh-setup bundles the four skills you run once, when a repo is new, rather than on every commit. label-bootstrap force-syncs the 10-label SSOT plus its three alias renames and two pipeline-state labels, and deletes nothing unless --prune is passed. kanban-bootstrap creates the Projects v2 board, links the repo, replaces the Status options with the six-column workflow, and delegates its label step to label-bootstrap. docs-bootstrap scaffolds the eight-leaf kind-split docs/ tree with a .gitkeep per leaf and one policy README, dry-run by default. add-ai-metrics retrofits the ai-metrics footer onto Issues and PRs created before capture was automatic, idempotently and byte-identically outside the footer block. All four need an authenticated gh CLI; kanban-bootstrap additionally needs the project token scope.
defaultPrompt: Bootstrap this new repo's labels and kanban board.
Scaffold the standard docs tree here.
